playbooks.title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting
playbooks.methodology: Inject a unique marker into reflected parameters; flag when it returns unencoded in an executable context.
playbooks.remediation: Context-encode output and deploy a strict Content-Security-Policy; rely on framework auto-escaping.

playbooks.title: DOM / Client-Side XSS
playbooks.methodology: Render in a real browser; inject handler payloads and confirm actual script EXECUTION, not reflection.
playbooks.remediation: Avoid dangerous sinks (innerHTML, document.write, eval); use textContent/safe bindings and strict CSP.

playbooks.title: SQL Injection (error + boolean)
playbooks.methodology: Single-quote and parenthesis-breakout variants to surface DB errors across MySQL/Postgres/SQLite/Oracle/MSSQL; else boolean-differential.
detect_signatures: you have an error in your sql syntax
playbooks.remediation: Use parameterized queries/prepared statements or a vetted ORM; never concatenate input into SQL.

playbooks.title: NoSQL Injection
playbooks.methodology: Inject operator/JSON payloads ($ne, $gt, [$ne]) and watch for MongoDB/driver errors or auth bypass behaviour.
playbooks.remediation: Validate/cast types, reject operator objects from user input, and use parameterized driver APIs.

playbooks.title: Server-Side Template Injection
playbooks.methodology: Inject arithmetic markers ({{7*7}} -> 49) and confirm the engine evaluated them (result present, literal absent).
playbooks.remediation: Never pass user input into template source; use logic-less/sandboxed engines with bound context variables.

playbooks.title: Path Traversal / LFI
playbooks.methodology: Request a known read-only file via traversal sequences and match its signature; read-only probing only.
playbooks.remediation: Canonicalize paths and confirm they stay within an allowed base; prefer opaque server-mapped identifiers.

playbooks.title: Open Redirect
playbooks.methodology: Set redirect params to an external canary and confirm it reaches the Location header on 3xx.
playbooks.remediation: Do not build redirect targets from user input; allow-list destinations or use mapping keys.

playbooks.title: XML External Entity
playbooks.methodology: For XML-accepting endpoints, submit a benign external-entity doc and watch for entity expansion or parser errors (no OOB/file exfil here).
playbooks.remediation: Disable external entities and DTDs in the XML parser; prefer JSON or a hardened parser config.

playbooks.title: HTTP Header / CRLF Injection
playbooks.methodology: Inject CRLF + a canary header/value into reflected header params and check it surfaces in the response headers/body.
playbooks.remediation: Strip CR/LF from values placed in headers; use framework header APIs that encode or reject control chars.

playbooks.title: Sensitive File / Info Disclosure
playbooks.methodology: Probe well-known sensitive paths (VCS, env, config, backups, status) and match tell-tale signatures.
playbooks.remediation: Remove secrets/VCS/backups from the web root, block dot-paths at the edge, and disable status/debug pages in prod.

playbooks.title: Subdomain Takeover
playbooks.methodology: Fetch the host and match known dangling-provider fingerprints indicating an unclaimed backend.
detect_signatures: there isn't a github pages site here
the specified bucket does not exist
playbooks.remediation: Remove dangling DNS records or reclaim the backend resource; monitor CNAMEs pointing to third-party providers.

playbooks.title: Missing Security Headers
playbooks.methodology: Inspect the origin for baseline hardening headers; report once per origin.
playbooks.remediation: Add CSP, X-Frame-Options (or frame-ancestors), HSTS and X-Content-Type-Options to every response.

playbooks.title: Insecure Direct Object Reference
playbooks.methodology: Object-reference params need two authenticated identities to confirm; flag the surface for manual auth-context testing.
playbooks.remediation: Enforce server-side authorization on every object access; deny by default and use unpredictable ids.

playbooks.title: Server-Side Request Forgery
playbooks.methodology: URL-fetch params need an out-of-band collector to confirm; flag the surface for OOB validation.
playbooks.remediation: Allow-list outbound destinations, block internal/link-local ranges and the metadata endpoint, disable unused schemes.

playbooks.title: Cross-Site Request Forgery
playbooks.methodology: State-changing endpoints without anti-CSRF tokens; flag POST/PUT/DELETE surfaces for manual token review.
playbooks.remediation: Require per-session anti-CSRF tokens (or SameSite=strict cookies) on all state-changing requests.

playbooks.title: Mass Assignment
playbooks.methodology: Object-write endpoints may bind unexpected fields (role, isAdmin); flag for manual field-whitelist testing.
playbooks.remediation: Explicitly allow-list bindable fields server-side; never bind request bodies directly to models.

playbooks.title: Insecure Deserialization
playbooks.methodology: Serialized blobs in params/cookies may be deserialized unsafely; flag for manual gadget testing (no active exploit).
playbooks.remediation: Avoid native deserialization of untrusted data; use signed, schema-validated formats (e.g. JSON) with allow-lists.

playbooks.title: JWT / Authentication Weaknesses
playbooks.methodology: Flag JWT/auth surfaces for manual testing of alg=none, weak secrets, and signature stripping.
playbooks.remediation: Pin the signing algorithm, verify signatures, reject alg=none, and use strong rotated secrets/keys.

playbooks.title: Broken Function-Level Authorization
playbooks.methodology: Admin/privileged function paths reachable without role checks; flag for manual role-based testing.
playbooks.remediation: Enforce role checks server-side on every privileged function; deny by default.

playbooks.title: Race Conditions
playbooks.methodology: Value/state-changing endpoints may be exploitable via parallel requests; flag for manual concurrency testing.
playbooks.remediation: Use atomic operations, database locks or idempotency keys on sensitive state transitions.

playbooks.title: Business Logic Flaws
playbooks.methodology: Price/quantity/workflow params may allow logic abuse (negative amounts, step-skipping); flag for manual testing.
playbooks.remediation: Enforce server-side invariants and workflow state checks; never trust client-supplied business values.

playbooks.title: Insecure File Upload
playbooks.methodology: Upload endpoints may accept dangerous types/paths; flag for manual type/path and execution testing.
playbooks.remediation: Validate type/extension/content server-side, store outside the web root, and randomize names.

playbooks.title: Remote Code Execution (surface)
playbooks.methodology: Command/eval surfaces are flagged for manual, authorized validation only; Qannas does not auto-exploit RCE.
playbooks.remediation: Never pass user input to shells/evaluators; use safe APIs, strict allow-lists and sandboxing.

playbooks.title: HTTP Request Smuggling
playbooks.methodology: Front-end/back-end parsing differentials; flag for manual CL.TE/TE.CL testing (not auto-sent).
playbooks.remediation: Normalize/measure request framing at the edge, reject ambiguous Content-Length/Transfer-Encoding combinations.

playbooks.title: Argument Injection
playbooks.methodology: Input reaching argv/CLI builders may smuggle options; flag for manual option-boundary testing.
playbooks.remediation: Pass user data as operands after `--`, validate against allow-lists, avoid building command strings.

playbooks.title: Prototype Pollution
playbooks.methodology: JSON merge/assign endpoints may accept __proto__ keys; flag for manual pollution testing.
playbooks.remediation: Reject __proto__/constructor keys, use null-prototype objects or Maps, and freeze prototypes.

playbooks.title: Weak Password / Credential Policy
playbooks.methodology: Auth endpoints may permit weak credentials or lack lockout; flag for manual policy/brute-force review.
playbooks.remediation: Enforce strong password policy, rate limiting and lockout, and support MFA.

playbooks.title: Parser / Semantic Confusion
playbooks.methodology: Validation vs consumer parser differentials (URL/encoding); flag for manual differential testing.
playbooks.remediation: Validate on the canonical form the consumer uses; align parser behaviour across validation and use.

playbooks.title: LLM Prompt Injection
playbooks.methodology: Endpoints feeding user input to an LLM may be injectable; flag for manual prompt-injection testing.
playbooks.remediation: Isolate untrusted input from instructions, constrain tool use, and validate/guard model outputs.

playbooks.title: Agentic System Security
playbooks.methodology: Agent/tool-exposing endpoints may allow tool abuse or goal hijacking; flag for manual agent-security testing.
playbooks.remediation: Constrain tool permissions, require authorization per action, and sandbox agent execution.
